name: Khazi
description: A planeswalker harvested when an Eternal grabbed her through the chapel wall.

description_citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
description_citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane, pinned down in an old chapel by Eternals, calls up through the grate and reports that Khazi was harvested.
timeline.quote: Khazi was harvested when an Eternal punched its hand right through the wall and grabbed her by the wrist.
